records.evidence_slice: The UK National Data Library publishes the Office for National Statistics dataset Wards (December 2024) Boundaries UK BGC. It contains UK ward digital vector boundaries at BGC generalised 20m resolution clipped to the coastline. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward code E05009390 to this previously unused December 2024 BGC source window; no feature geometry or parcel spatial join is materialized.
